# TossMap

> TossMap is an independent directory of waste and recycling drop-off options in US cities, using government and facility-operator sources. It does not operate the listed facilities.

Listings include accepted materials, addresses, hours, fees, eligibility notes, source links and last-checked dates where available. 113 drop-off sites are listed across 54 US metros. Rules and hours can change. Confirm with the linked operator before driving; a listing does not guarantee acceptance, availability or free service. Do not treat household waste listings as permission to bring commercial waste.

## Find a drop-off
- [Cities and materials](https://tossmap.com/): directory index
- [Paint](https://tossmap.com/paint/): 88 official listings in 48 metro areas
- [Electronics (e-waste)](https://tossmap.com/e-waste/): 32 official listings in 15 metro areas
- [Tires](https://tossmap.com/tires/): 36 official listings in 14 metro areas
- [Batteries](https://tossmap.com/batteries/): 93 official listings in 49 metro areas
- [Motor oil](https://tossmap.com/motor-oil/): 93 official listings in 46 metro areas
- [Household chemicals](https://tossmap.com/household-chemicals/): 84 official listings in 48 metro areas
